worldcombat.skill.charm.summary: Cuddle up to a foe you can see and charm its fighting spirit away, harshly lowering its Attack; cover blocks the gaze. You may instead blow a kiss to reach farther, but it takes less out of them.
worldcombat.skill.charm.use.0: Soften a physical threat that has closed in
worldcombat.skill.charm.use.1: Blunt an attacker's blows before it reaches you
worldcombat.skill.charm.use.2: Top up the drop with a kiss from a little farther
worldcombat.skill.charm.description.0: The charmed target loses %1$s Attack stage(s) and stays smitten for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.charm.description.1: Charm range %1$s; cover beyond that cannot be reached, and one cast scatters %2$s hearts.
worldcombat.skill.charm.description.2: Windup %1$s with a %2$s cooldown. The gaze must be seen and is blocked by cover; single target only.
worldcombat.skill.charm.kiss.off: Cuddle: you must get close, but it removes 2 stages and lingers longer.
worldcombat.skill.charm.kiss.on: Blown kiss: reaches much farther, but removes only 1 stage, lingers shorter, and winds up and cools down slower.
worldcombat.skill.charm.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
When on, sends a kiss through the air: much longer range, but only 1 Attack stage, shorter duration, and slower windup and cooldown; off means you must get close for 2 stages that last.
worldcombat.skill.charm.preference.ai.ma: The companion only considers charm while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it at point-blank, larger starts sooner.
worldcombat.skill.charm.preference.ai.op: Countering charms only while the enemy attacks the companion or its owner, or right after a hit; Anytime charms at any threat.
worldcombat.skill.charm.preference.ai.le: When on, the companion may leave its post to charm under a Hold order.
